DROP PROCEDURE [d360].[SP_hash_log_GLD]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [d360].[SP_hash_log_GLD] AS
BEGIN
CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Sequence
,       [TABLE_NAME]
,       'WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+TABLE_NAME+' WHERE H = ''D''
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,''F-'','''') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+TABLE_NAME+' WHERE H <> ''D''
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,''_SRC'','''') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) src

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT )
) pvt2' 
 AS sql_code

FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables  WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME  in(
'STG_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE'
,'STG_GLD_AUXINFO1'
,'STG_GLD_AUXINFO2'
,'STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE'
,'STG_GLD_GENACCTMASTTABLE'
,'STG_GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE'
,'STG_GLD_GLSUBHEADTRANTABLE'
,'STG_GLD_TRANDETAIL'
)
;


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE Sequence = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),FXD_CRNCY_UNITS)),0) FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),VAR_CRNCY_UNITS)),0) VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,FXD_CRNCY_UNITS FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_src
,VAR_CRNCY_UNITS VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_src
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
,VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
,FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_src
,VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_src
, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
,CAST(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
,CAST(FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_src
,CAST(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_src
,VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_src )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,FXD_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt
,VAR_CRNCY_UNITS_tgt )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');

END
GO
